findings: Study context and its explicit return appear above the complete 2D diagram.
Named chosen and marked structure blocks provide a clear function comparison; Next and Return have primary styling.
Matching saved selection stays concealed during an unanswered round, and paused Explore restores labels and controls.
Phone, larger Arabic text, contrast and forced colors retain readable labels and avoid clipped content.
Visual follow-up identified: the two authored English function paragraphs should use dir=auto within Arabic feedback to keep sentence punctuation in reading order.

scope.contrastMethod: Computed foreground against first solid opaque ancestor background; full-model screenshots reviewed separately.

diagnostics.reason: Fixture focused the old search node before React committed the navigation.
Fixture used search inside collapsed Spotter settings as its deliberate focus target.
Source summaries were 14px; source fixed to 16/17px. Fixture aligned to full named h6 headings.
Four journeys and fifteen clean scans passed; matrix exceeded 300s while saving Arabic dark capture. Only its time budget increased to 900s.
